structured_output.mechanisms: Time ≈ steps × per-step cost (fixed overhead plus conv FLOPs, scaled by batch size). Low-resolution phases cut cost of those steps (cost ≈ 0.2 + 0.8·(res/32)²) but cost accuracy, more so with three phases, so they usually miss 75.3%. Accuracy rises with width and epochs; translate4, cutout, random flip and extreme label smoothing hurt. E016 (same config as E012, much slower and worse) looks like an unmodeled hidden change.
